title: GiftRules
description: When gifts may be proposed and where they may land (B6 R8, F5238). All numbers are placeholders until Marcel decides (PR4, F5231).

futile_attempts_threshold.description: Failed attempts at the same need before a gift may be suggested.

suggestion_expiry_hours.description: Game hours until an untaken suggestion lapses.

min_distance_to_inhabitant_m.description: A gift never lands on or right next to an inhabitant.

urgent_below.description: A need below this value counts as pressing: an action that ends while nothing in sight seems to help counts as a futile attempt (placeholder, Marcel's value).

missing_radius_m.description: The core's check 'really missing': if any object that truly helps lies within this distance, no help is offered; the inhabitant is to search (F5238; placeholder).

search_actions.description: Actions that count as trying to find something (searching, examining); only these count as futile effort, not sleeping or resting (GW1 review #67 S2).
